display.purpose: Hero display headers and screen titles.

body.purpose: Primary readable UI labels, descriptions, and inputs.

label.purpose: Currency amounts, tabular figures, and calculator numpad.

components.name: Volt Button
components.description: Primary tactile button for confirmation and submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-volt { background: #D9F938; color: #070806; font-family: 'Satoshi', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(217, 249, 56, 0.2); transition: all 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-volt:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Smoked Card
components.description: Translucent glass card container for dashboard metrics and forms.
components.css: .ds-card-smoked { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: KromaLedger is designed as a precision handheld financial instrument: dark, quiet, tactile, and laser-focused.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian & Smoked Glass surfaces with hairline translucent borders
Electric Volt (#D9F938) accent reserved for focal actions
Cabinet Grotesk display + Satoshi body + JetBrains Mono figures

rules.name: The 5% Volt Rule
rules.body: Electric Volt is used on <=5% of any screen. Its rarity commands instant focus.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: All financial amounts, dates, and numpad keys must use font-mono tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through surface translucency and hairline borders, not opaque stacked shadows.

dos: Do format every currency balance and transaction amount in JetBrains Mono (font-mono tabular-nums).
Do keep cards and modal surfaces translucent with backdrop-blur-md and border border-white/[.08].
Do reserve Electric Volt #D9F938 for primary calls to action, active indicators, and critical metrics.
donts: Don't use standard blue, purple, or rainbow gradients.
Don't use sharp 0px corners on interactive cards or buttons.
Don't use light-mode backgrounds or low-contrast gray text on dark cards.
